messages:
alex: Quick instrumentation quick-scan: token-cost attribution & latency breakdowns update. TL;DR: schema stabilized, PRs up, one blocking dependency on emb-field rename. owners needed for cost-query dashboards.

maria: thanks — can you drop the PR links and expected ship date? :eyes: 

alex: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/482 (schema); https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/219 (latency-breakdown). aiming for canary this Fri (3/12). blockers: emb-field rename needs eng-ml approval.

rishi: I'll take ownership of latency-breakdown dashboard. ETA EOD Thu to wire sample queries and unit tests.

priya: re cost-query dashboards — who owns the costing aggregation? @sam? we need the rollup key defined (customer_id vs account_id).

sam: I own cost-agg. prefer account_id; customer_id gets noisy across partitions. I'll update schema to add rollup_key: "account_id" and push a small PR.

sam: ```json
{"event_name":"model_infer","tokens":42,"cost_usd":0.0023,"rollup_key":"account_id"}
```

ci-bot: build failed on telemetry PR #219 — integration tests flaked in ingest smoke. Logs: `timeout while waiting for schema migration`.

alex: ok let's not merge until ci is green and eng-ml signs off on emb rename. @rishi @priya can you two coordinate on the fallback mapping (if emb field missing map to legacy_embedding) and add to PR comments?

rishi: yep will add mapping + unit tests this afternoon.

priya: tagging analytics for dashboard contract: @maria can you confirm the cost attribution time-window (30m or 1h)?

maria: go with 1h for now, we can tighten later. :+1: 

alex: plan: 1) rishi adds tests + mapping, 2) sam updates rollup_key PR, 3) eng-ml review on emb rename, 4) ci green -> canary Fri. I'll post final checklist in #eng-platform tomorrow morning.

sam: pinging reviewers for quick CR — FYI I'll hold the merge until canary ok. :hand: 

maria: noted. thanks all.
